reviews.title: Immediate improvement over EE
reviews.body:
Switching to Lebara had two immediate results. The first was that phone calls to / from our home location have a much better signal. We had previously only had sufficient EE signal in some parts if the garden. The second was the monthly cost reduced.
The lack of contract tie-in made it low risk to try. In the event, within a couple if days of adding the Lebara SIM I cancelled EE.
